name: Club Friday Hot Love Issue: Love Trial
original_name: คลับฟรายเดย์เดอะซีรีส์ Hot Love Issue เรื่องรัก เรื่องร้อน ตอน รักต้องลอง (ใจ)
overview: In this new era of social media dominance emerges contemporary occupations such as the "Love Trial Service." When doubts arise about your partner's fidelity, you can purchase a love trial package. They offer a wide range of trial periods at different prices. The objective is to contact a client's partner through various social media platforms and attempt to initiate conversation, form friendships, or even romantic relationships. Once a reaction is obtained—any—the next steps are in the client's hands.
